note: Additions to the shared ../roles.json, and the shared roles this variant declares absent. A delta rather than a second manifest: a role threaded in one variant and forgotten in the other is invisible to every other gate, because supertype matching is derivation-based and a missing thread just returns fewer nodes.

_binding.why: Every one of these is a python 3 construct: PEP 634 as-patterns, the walrus, `nonlocal`, PEP 3132 starred assignment, and PEP 695 type aliases and type parameters. They are not node types in this variant at all, so they cannot be facet members here.
